funfacts.sentence: When playing at home, Gimcheon Sangmu have not lost to FC Anyang in their last 4 encounters.
Gimcheon Sangmu's home record this season: 1-10-3.
FC Anyang's away record this season: 5-6-4.

ai_preview.text:
**Gimcheon's home form is the real story here** — they're unbeaten in five (1W, 3D, 1L) and looking to capitalize on that Bucheon rout last time out. Anyang, though? Inconsistent is putting it kindly — one win in five and a nasty loss to Daejeon have them on the back foot. 🔴

Head-to-head leans Gimcheon's way (2 wins in the last five), and playing at home usually matters. **Sangmu's defensive solidarity** (that 0-0 clean sheet vs Pohang) gives them the edge here.

Key storylines:

- **Gimcheon's attacking spark**: L. Sangheon and R. Kyung-ho have been clinical when the chances come — the Bucheon shutout showed their teeth.
- **Anyang's fragility**: After that 2-3 collapse to Daejeon, B. Knežević and the midfield need to tighten up fast.
- **Home advantage matters**: Gimcheon haven't dropped many points at their stadium lately.

Expected lineups:

- **Gimcheon Sangmu FC**: P. Man-Ho, Y. Hong, L. Kang-Hyeon, B. Jun-Soo, S. H. Hong, I. Kim, T. Park, D. Lim, R. Kyung-ho, J. Jae-Min, L. Sangheon
- **FC Anyang**: D. S. Kim, D. J. Kim, K. W. Kwon, Y. C. Kim, J. H. Kang, B. Knežević, J. H. Kim, J. Lee, G. Choi, M. Oliveira, Airton

Prediction:

**Gimcheon 2–1 Anyang**. Sangmu's home form and head-to-head edge give them the slight favorite lean. 📍
